# CHAOS CLOSET — generated artwork and final prompts

Built-in image_gen tool, not CLI. All final PNGs live in this assets directory. The original files remain in Codex generated_images. Reference for six costumes: ../../assets/parts-base-v1.png, the existing fictional adult Korean character age 24. The new mode borrows only the general playful dress-up game idea; no original Shu character, logo or game artwork was used.

The costumes are complete full-body illustrations. render.js uses a single uniform scale for each image, never changing the head/body or horizontal/vertical proportions independently. Companion props are original code-native canvas graphics beside the character.

## duck-v1.png

Use case: identity-preserve. Edit target: same fictional adult Korean woman age 24 in the reference, for Virtual Character Dress Up's original CHAOS CLOSET comedy mode. Keep the exact face identity, adult realistic anatomy, full-body frontal standing pose, arms relaxed slightly away from torso, both hands visible and empty, same camera and body registration. Change the complete costume to: A crisp white shirt with orange necktie, dark tailored trousers, white sneakers, and a comically large bright yellow rubber-duck swim ring worn naturally around the waist. Normal human head, no headgear, friendly embarrassed little smile. Inflatable duck is clearly around the hips, fully clothed office worker comedy. Style: polished realistic 3D CGI fashion illustration with playful absurd props, not pixel art, not anime, not a copyrighted existing game or mascot. All clothes correctly fitted to this body; natural shoulder width, waist at the real waist, normal limb lengths, natural head-to-body ratio around seven heads. Entire headgear and shoes must fit in the portrait with transparent padding; no cropping. True transparent alpha background, no backdrop, no floor, no glow, no text, no watermark, no extra people. Match soft studio light.

## laundry-v1.png

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: background for an original absurd comedy dress-up browser game, realistic 3D CGI illustration, not pixel art. Wide interior of a cheerful pastel lavender and peach fashion fitting room crossed with a coin laundromat in outer space: rounded chrome washing machines along side walls, a playful rubber duck cushion, hanging colorful clothes on rails, a small floating wall clock with bent hands, a circular window showing a gentle pastel starfield. Empty center floor and wall area for a full-body adult character to be composited in front. Eye-level frontal camera, polished soft studio lights, realistic fabric/chrome textures, charming whimsical atmosphere rather than scary. Portrait composition, center clear and spacious, no characters, no text, no logos, no branding, no UI. Light warm cream center backdrop so clothing remains legible. Original world design.

## Original BGM

chaos-laundry-v1.wav: Chaos Laundry, original 32-second / 120 BPM stereo PCM loop synthesized by scripts/generate-chaos-bgm.mjs. No sampled commercial music or voice recordings. Existing generated grade expressions are reused from ../../assets/reaction-{s,a,b,c}-v1.png.
